_description: Area inputs of the 128 x 128 1F1C config (one array: 128 data columns and ISAAC's unit column, each with its column readout) that are not in design.json, each with its source in _provenance. The cell array area is not here: it is results/nvsim.json -> array.array_area_um2 (28 nm).

_provenance.adc.per_array: One buffer, sample-and-hold and SAR ADC per column (Laleni et al. 2024, Fig. 9, Sec. IV): 128 data columns + 1 unit column (design.json encoding)
_provenance.adc.bits, source_bits: design.json adc.bits (8, ISAAC Eq. 2 with the weight-flip encoding); the source ADC (CAP-RAM) is 7-bit. An ADC of more bits than the source scales its area by 2^(bits - source_bits): ISAAC Sec. III, 'some ADC overheads grow exponentially with resolution', and our SAR keeps its unit capacitor, so its capacitive DAC doubles per bit (spice/adc/sar_full_tb_8b.sp)
_provenance.adc.source_area_um2, source_node_nm, dee: As ../default/area.json: CAP-RAM (Chen et al., IEEE JSSC, arXiv 2107.02388), Sec. III-B, per-column 7-bit ciSAR ADC, 429 um^2 in 65-nm LP CMOS; DeepScaleTool area factor 65 -> 28 nm
_provenance.column_frontend: The 8-bit ADC's front end (spice/adc/sar_full_tb_8b.sp): buffer_ab re-sized by spice/adc/run_frontend_resize.py (CC=75f, N2=8, N6=12, CLS=200f, design.json adc.buffer_bias_uA), bootsw unchanged (CB=25f, WS=500n). Area per column and layout rules as ../default/area.json _provenance
_provenance.column_frontend.transistors_W_L_nm: In order: buffer_ab MB 1u/200n, MT 2u/200n, M1 2u/200n, M2 2u/200n, M3 0.5u/200n, M4 0.5u/200n, M6 6u/200n (500n x N6=12), M7 8u/200n (1u x N2=8); bootsw MN1, MP2, MN3 200n/32n, MP4 400n/32n, MN5 400n/32n, MS 500n/32n (sar_frontend.lib)
